events.name: The Playground
events.intro:
Something small and pink keeps darting behind your party, just out of sight. In a clearing, pebbles float in a ring. One is not a pebble.

The not-pebble opens one eye. For a second your lead turns into a Ditto-shaped blob, then back. Nobody did that.

A sign, painted on a stump in a child's letters: PLAY WITH ME OR GO AWAY

success.text: Three games. Hide-and-seek: it turns into one of your Pokémon and you have to spot which (you do, by the giggle). Tag: it transforms faster than you can run. Copy-me: it copies your last three moves in a mock battle, perfectly, and bows.
It follows anyway, sulking, three steps behind. When you look in your bag, something is missing.
You sit. A minute passes. Then something light lands on your head and stays there, humming.

events.name: Mew: The Promise

remembers.notice: Mew is still sulking a little. It points at you anyway.

events.intro:
Mew floats at eye level and points at your party. Then at itself. Then at your party again.

The Promise: Bring everyone: no two Pokémon in the party share the same pair of types.

success.text: Mew spins in the air, delighted, and settles in beside you. Your party counts their types, nervously.

effects.text: Mew came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Mew leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Mew will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Forest of Time
events.intro:
A tree you passed an hour ago is a sapling again. A green sparkle hangs where it used to be tall.

A moss-covered shrine. Three bowls. An old forester sits by it, and you realise, slowly, that he is also the boy who carved his initials on that sapling.

Forester: "It takes things back. When it's sad. Someone cut the old wood down. It's been undoing it ever since. A tree at a time."

success.text: Water, a seed, and a memory: you tell the bowls a story of your run so far. The third bowl fills with light.
The forester gives you three saplings and marks three clearings on your map, one far ahead of the next. You plant the first.
Behind you, another tree becomes a sapling.

events.name: The Forest of Time: A Sapling
events.intro: The second clearing the forester marked. The stump is old; the ground around it is soft.

success.text: It takes. A little further on, a tree that was a sapling this morning is tall again.
The clearing waits.

events.name: The Forest of Time: A Sapling
events.intro: The last clearing. You plant the third sapling, and the air goes green.

success.text: Celebi is there, at the last sapling, as if it had always been.
The clearing waits.

events.name: The Forest of Time: Celebi
events.intro:
Celebi flickers. For a moment you see the forest as it was, and a younger forester, running between the trees, laughing.

Celebi holds out its hands.

success.text: The forest is quiet. Nothing more turns back.

events.name: Celebi: The Promise
events.intro:
Celebi waits, very small, by your shoulder.

The Promise: Harm no wood: knock out no wild Grass- or Bug-type.

success.text: Celebi rests on your shoulder. Behind you, the old wood grows a little taller.

effects.text: Celebi came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Celebi leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Celebi will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Seven Nights
events.intro:
A comet. A paper strip drifts down and lands in your hand. It says: "Wish."

That night, under the stars, a sleepy voice.
Jirachi: "I'm awake for seven nights. Then I sleep for a thousand years. What do you wish for?"

success.text: Jirachi grants it: something better than you would have found. It frowns a little while it does.
You name someone you met this run. Far away, things go a little better for them. Jirachi looks at you properly for the first time.
Jirachi: "Nobody says that." It sits down next to you and stays.

events.name: Jirachi: The Promise
events.intro:
Jirachi yawns. "Seven nights. Will you keep me company?"

The Promise: Refuse no one: agree to every request made of you in an event.

success.text: Jirachi tucks itself into your bag, the paper strip on its head, and falls asleep.

effects.text: Jirachi came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Jirachi leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Jirachi does not forgive. Break it once and it is gone.

events.name: The Signal
events.intro:
A faint repeating signal from a crater that was not there yesterday. It hums in three tones: long, short, long. A rock panel with three slots.

A radio amateur, arriving breathless: "It's been sending that for six days. It's not random. It's waiting for an answer."

success.text: The crater hums back, pleased. A new pattern starts.
The crater goes quiet. It will try again later.
The crater goes quiet. It will try again later.

events.name: The Signal: Again
events.intro: The crater is humming again. Long, short, long. The amateur waves at you from the rim.

success.text: The crater hums back, pleased. A new pattern starts.
The crater goes quiet. It will try again later.
The crater goes quiet. It will try again later.

events.name: The Signal: Round Two
events.intro: A new pattern: short, short, short.

success.text: The crater goes quiet. It will try again later.
The crater hums back, pleased. A new pattern starts.
The crater goes quiet. It will try again later.

events.name: The Signal: Round Three
events.intro: The last pattern, slower: long, long, long.

success.text: The crater goes quiet. It will try again later.
The crater goes quiet. It will try again later.
The crater hums back, pleased.

events.name: The Signal: Deoxys
events.intro:
Deoxys is in the crater, changing form every few seconds: arms, then armour, then speed.

The amateur: "It's trying on shapes to see which one we'll like."

success.text: It settles into its Normal Forme, and seems relieved.
A blur, and it is behind you, and back.
Its arms thicken. The crater floor cracks.

events.name: Deoxys: The Promise
events.intro:
The amateur lowers the radio. Deoxys is looking at you, not the sky.

The Promise: Change with me: never lead with the same Pokémon two stages running.

success.text: Deoxys changes shape one more time, into something almost like your lead, and follows.

effects.text: Deoxys came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Deoxys leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Deoxys will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Little Egg
events.intro:
A tiny bubble-like Pokémon floats on the tide, bobbing along without a care. The tide is pulling it toward a rip current. It does not notice.

A lifeguard, from a tower: "That's not a swimmer!"

success.text: Your Water-type is in the sea before you finish saying it, and back with the little one riding on its head.
The lifeguard's float, a long throw, and a very wet Phione at your feet.
The current takes it round the point. You hear it laugh, faintly, far out.

events.name: Phione: The Promise
events.intro:
Phione shakes itself dry and looks along the coast, then up at you.

The Promise: Take me along the coast: whenever a path by water is offered, take it.

success.text: Phione bobs along beside you, always on the side nearer the water.

effects.text: Phione came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Phione leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Phione will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Empty Arena
events.intro:
A ruined arena. An old trophy case is warm to the touch, and a flame flickers inside where no fire could be. The empty stadium cheers. For nobody.

A voice from the stands: "Do you win for glory, or for them?"

success.text: Victini appears, unimpressed, and challenges your lead to a one-on-one.
Victini appears on your shoulder.
Victini laughs. Under it, a subtitle: "Honest." It appears.

events.name: The Empty Arena: Again
events.intro: Victini, hovering over your lead: "Again."

success.text: One more time.
The stadium stops cheering.

events.name: Victini: The Promise
events.intro:
The stadium is roaring now. Victini holds up two fingers in a V.

The Promise: Never turn away: flee no battle and decline no challenge.

success.text: Victini rides on your lead's head out of the arena. The cheering follows you a long way.

effects.text: Victini came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Victini leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Victini will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Gratitude Garden
events.intro:
A field blooms out of season. One hedgehog-shaped bush is suspiciously round. In the afternoon heat the flowers wilt, one by one, and the round bush trembles.

A farmer's daughter: "They come back every year if someone says thank you to them. Nobody's said it for ages."

success.text: The field un-wilts, all of it, at once. The bush unrolls. It is Shaymin.
Two long stretches of road with a heavy, prickly bush in your arms. At the spring it drinks, revives, and for a moment is something with wings.
Shaymin wakes, deeply offended, and runs. You will have to find it again.

events.name: The Gratitude Garden: Again
events.intro: Another field, another round bush, very still, pretending to be a bush.

success.text: The bush unrolls a little. Then all the way.
The flowers close behind you.

events.name: Shaymin: The Promise
events.intro:
Shaymin sniffs your hand, then the field, then you.

The Promise: Take no payment for kindness: choose every generous ending an event offers.

success.text: Shaymin rides in a pocket of flowers, and wherever you rest, something blooms.

effects.text: Shaymin came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Shaymin leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Shaymin will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Unfinished Song
events.intro:
A music box in a roadside stall plays half a song. A soft voice finishes the next bar, from nowhere.

The stall owner: "It does that. I've had three customers faint."
Meloetta, unseen: "Three notes left. Do you know them?"

The music box's last bar went down, down, down.

success.text: The voice sings it with you.
The voice waits, then sings the note you did not.
The voice waits, then sings the note you did not.

events.name: The Unfinished Song: Note 2
events.intro: The second note. The bar before it climbed, like a bird taking off.

success.text: The voice waits, then sings the note you did not.
The voice sings it with you.
The voice waits, then sings the note you did not.

events.name: The Unfinished Song: Note 3
events.intro: The last note. The box falls silent, as if it wants a voice that is not yours.

success.text: The voice waits, then sings the note you did not.
The voice waits, then sings the note you did not.
The voice sings it with you.

events.name: The Unfinished Song: Meloetta
events.intro: The song is finished, one way or another.

branches.text: Meloetta appears, finishes the song and dances. The whole street stops to watch.
Meloetta appears and corrects you, kindly, humming the right notes until you have them.

success.text: Meloetta laughs, somewhere, and is gone. Next time the music box plays one extra bar.

events.name: Meloetta: The Promise
events.intro:
Meloetta sits on the music box, swinging her feet.

The Promise: Finish the song: never quit or skip a minigame once begun.

success.text: Meloetta hums the finished song as you walk. Your party walks in step.

effects.text: Meloetta came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Meloetta leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Meloetta will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: Rings of Mischief
events.intro: A gold ring hangs in the air over the path. Giggling comes from inside it.

success.text: Your hand comes out holding a coin that was never yours. The ring shrinks to nothing, still giggling.
It follows you for a step or two, sulks, and pops.

events.name: Rings of Mischief: The Second Ring
events.intro: The ring is back, over your bag this time.

success.text: Something goes in. Something else comes out: a berry, still warm from wherever it was.
A tug-of-war with thin air. The ring gives up, laughing, and goes.

events.name: Rings of Mischief: Hoopa
events.intro:
A gold ring hangs in the air. Your hand goes through and comes out holding someone else's sandwich. Three rings float side by side, giggling.

A shopkeeper, furious, running up: "That was my sandwich!"

success.text: Hoopa pops out, disappointed that you are no fun, and hands you the shopkeeper's other sandwich.
You come out further down the road, holding a coin of your own you lost three stages ago.
Hoopa is pulled out by its own ring, upside down, laughing so hard it cannot float.

events.name: Hoopa: The Promise
events.intro:
Hoopa juggles its rings and grins at your bag.

The Promise: Let me play: it takes one random item a stage; keep at least three items in the bag.

success.text: Hoopa hangs a ring on your bag strap, and peeks out of it from time to time.

effects.text: Hoopa came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Hoopa leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Hoopa will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Shadow That Punches
events.intro: All stage your shadow has been throwing punches you did not throw. At dusk it stands apart from you, takes a stance, and waits. Nobody else can see it.

success.text: A sparring match with your own shadow.

win.text: Your shadow sparred with you once, and bowed.

success.text: No answer. It points, and in the dark you see your last lost battle, played over again in shadow. Then it is just your shadow.
When you look back, it is just a shadow, sulking.

events.name: The Sixteen Pedestals
events.intro:
At the last rest before the League, a plate of stone lies half-buried, carved with a circle of sixteen. You brush the dirt off it, and the rest is gone.

A dark hall. Sixteen pedestals. Each has a Plate on it except one.

A voice from everywhere: "You have kept your word. To one of mine, all the way here."
The voice: "What do you bring to the seventeenth?"

success.text: The voice is silent for a long time.
The voice: "They are not yours to bring." It waits for another answer.
The voice: "Good."

events.name: The Sixteen Pedestals
events.intro:
A dark hall. Sixteen pedestals. Each has a Plate on it except one.

A voice from everywhere: "You have kept your word. To one of mine, all the way here."
The voice: "What do you bring to the seventeenth?"

It is still waiting.

success.text: The voice is silent for a long time.
The voice: "Good."

events.name: Arceus: The Judgment
events.intro:
The voice: "Then hear the Judgment. Three commandments, for the rest of your road: heal less, pay more, and hold fewer. Keep them to the end, as you kept your word."

The sixteenth pedestal is empty. A Plate rises from it, and its power goes to your first partner's type. Then the voice asks you to change one rule of the world. Only one.

choices.label: "Let revival be as common as it used to be."

success.text: Your bag is heavier.

effects.text: Arceus judged you at the sixteen pedestals. You asked for revival to be common again.

success.text: Your whole party feels it: three levels, all at once.

effects.text: Arceus judged you at the sixteen pedestals. You asked for your Pokémon to be raised.

choices.label: "Set every rival back to the start."

success.text: Somewhere, every rival you have feels the ground move under them.

effects.text: Arceus judged you at the sixteen pedestals. You asked for every rival to be set back.

events.name: Arceus: The Judgment
events.intro:
The voice: "Then hear the Judgment. Two commandments, for the rest of your road: heal less, and pay more. Keep them to the end, as you kept your word."

The sixteenth pedestal is empty. A Plate rises from it, and its power goes to your first partner's type. Then the voice asks you to change one rule of the world. Only one.

events.name: Three Wishes for a Small Favour
events.intro:
A sweet-smelling peach on a roadside shrine. A thin purple ribbon trails from it into the grass.

A soft voice: "You look tired. I could help. Three wishes. For a small favour. Just take what I give you. That's all."

success.text: The voice: "Just accept my gifts. Every one." It says it plainly, as if that settles it.
Pecharunt rolls out of the peach, delighted.
The voice: "You'll come back."

events.name: Three Wishes: You Came Back
events.intro: The same peach, on a different shrine. The voice: "You came back. I said you would."

success.text: It was right.
The ribbon twitches in the grass behind you.

events.name: Pecharunt: The Promise
events.intro:
Pecharunt holds out a mochi, glistening. It is very sweet. It smells like a promise.

The Promise: Accept every gift: take whatever is offered to you by anyone.

success.text: Pecharunt climbs onto your bag. "Every gift," it says. "Every one."

effects.text: Pecharunt came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Pecharunt leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Pecharunt does not forgive. Break it once and it is gone.
